Maya: Quick summary — ran a synthetic preflight experiment for embeddings preflight + telemetry sampling. Goal: validate sample-rate tradeoffs for route-level telemetry under bursts.
Maya: Setup: 5 tenants, mixed dims [64, 128, 512], payload sizes 1–200k bytes, ramp 0->2000 req/s over 10m, ~50% multi-dim requests.
Maya: Runtime config: preflight enabled, sample_rate=0.1, preflight_timeout=150ms, fallback_policy=split-by-bytes. Ran on canary fleet.
Sam: Link to the raw load generator logs? :eyes:
Maya: Logs + perf gist: https://internal/gists/exp-1754440000
Maya: Key numbers:
```
- avg preflight latency: 38ms (p95 120ms)
- preflight pass rate: 86% (requests that passed preflight)
- telemetry events (sample=0.1): 22k events vs ~220k requests
- CPU on ingress: +12%
- splitter failures (413) during peak: 0.6% of requests
```
Phil: 0.6% 413 sounds... noticeable. Are those tied to a particular dim or client pattern? Which batch size did you use?
Maya: Most 413s came from 512-dim arrays where clients sent single giant blob (~200k bytes). Batching configured at 8; splitter couldn't chunk because client didn't send chunking header.
Sam: So client-side chunking or SDK hints would reduce that. Console should show per-tenant oversize counts and a quick hint: "suggest enabling chunking/size-hint header". Add a dashboard card.
Phil: On telemetry sampling: 0.1 cuts cost a lot but can miss short spikes. Did you try adaptive sampling (higher sample rate during anomaly windows)?
Maya: Yes — we instrumented a simple anomaly detector (requests/s spike + p95 latency) that flips sample_rate to 0.5 for 30s when triggered. That caught the peak and improved visibility; cost bump was small (~+3% total).
Maya: UX ask: Console should surface preflight pass/fail ratio, effective sample rate over time, and top 3 fail reasons (dims mismatch, bytes too large, preflight timeouts) per tenant/route.
Ryan: Rollout proposal: default sample_rate=0.05 global, enable adaptive-sampling behind FF for canary tenants, expose a toggle at Console -> Routes -> Preflight with a short blurb.
Sam: Also add an alert: if 413 rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m create an Ops incident with runbook link. That'll catch noisy client patterns before they affect SLOs.
Maya: Experiment notes saved to /playbooks/embeds/preflight/exp-1754440000.md
console-bot: Deploy canary flagged for preflight-adaptive-sr at 1754440300 :white_check_mark:
Maya: Next actions:
- Create dashboard panels (per-tenant preflight pass/fail, sample rate history, top fail reasons)
- Implement adaptive-sampling feature flag + rollout plan
- Add hint suggestion in SDK docs about including chunking/size-hint header and example snippets
Sam: I'll own the dashboard card and the alert rule. Phil — can you prototype the adaptive sampler logic and estimation of cost delta?
Phil: On it — prototyping today, ETA EOD Thursday.
Maya: Thanks all. Aim to monitor the canary for 48h before expanding to more tenants. Will post follow-ups with dashboards + runbook. :shipit:
